title: The Red Notebook
overview: Rumors spread about a mysterious figure in a hood as people start noticing surreal and terrifying apparitions.

title: The Shadow Enveloping the City
overview: Several girls hear a voice in the woods and notice a strange woman lurking in the background of their photos.

title: The Faceless Kid
overview: Fushigi's search for Himitsu leads him to the publishers Jimmy worked at while he was still completely human.

title: The Quiet Ripples
overview: Fushigi and Jimmy track down a cursed cell phone app that tricks users into committing risky and violent acts.

title: Blood-Soaked Feelings
overview: Jimmy and Fushigi try to save a girl curious about urban legends and a boy haunted by an amnesiac ghost.

title: The Wandering Dog
overview: Jimmy is turning into a Human-Faced Dog. Can Fushigi find a way to save him?

title: A Frenzy of Cruelty
overview: During two urban legend encounters, a girl meets a boy with a missing sister who is desperate to find Fushigi.
